customManagers.description: Versions the flux/kubernetes managers can't see, marked with '# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>' on the line above. For 'key: <depName>:<tag>' values (e.g. CNPG imageName) only the tag is captured

packageRules.description: Only allow version-like Docker tags (1, 1.2, 1.2.3, v1.2.3.4, with optional -suffix)

No apiVersion bumps: the kubernetes-api datasource is a static list, blind to which versions the cluster's CRDs serve (proposed notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 on Flux 2.7, which only serves v1beta3)
Services whose manifests sit in subdirectories: scope is the service, not the subdirectory
The operator chart does not carry a SeaweedFS version (the Seaweed CR's spec.image has no default), so both stay tracked but land in one PR

hostRules.description: ghcr.io answers bursts from this IP with 429, which aborts the run; run time does not matter
lscr.io fronts ghcr.io for linuxserver images
